Report filed by the State be kept with the records.
2. We find from the report that the prosecution intends to examine 8 (eight) witnesses, out of whom 2 (two) witnesses have already been examined.
The report says that the trial should conclude within six months.
3. We see that the petitioner in custody for a considerable period of time.
However, we also have to note that the victim lady is differently-abled.
The allegation is under Sections 376(2)(l)/511 of IPC.
The maximum punishment prescribed is life-term.
The victim lady, in her deposition, squarely implicates this petitioner.
